newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Aeroflot, Lufthansa renew jet service deal.
newsitem.headline: Aeroflot, Lufthansa renew jet service deal.

text.p: Lufthansa Technik AG (LHT) and Aeroflot have renewed an agreement under which the German group services the Russian international carrier's Airbus A-310-300 fleet, LHT's said in a statement on Friday.
LHT will continue to handle all servicing under a Total Technical Support contract and will assist Aeroflot in setting up a maintenance centre at Moscow's Sheremetyevo airport.
The new agreement will run until 2002. It takes effect on January 1, 1997. LHT has been servicing eight A-310-300s, which Aeroflot operates under leasing contracts.
In April 1999, a further two A-310-300s belonging to another Russian carrier, Diamond Sakha Airlines, and operated by Aeroflot, will be added to contract, the statement said.
